ideas.title: GOP Pushes for Accountability in Minnesota Somali Fraud Case
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota Somali fraud case and the GOP's push for Governor Walz and AG Ellison to step down.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the handling of the case.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
How did the Governor and AG handle the case?
ideas.insight: The case has significant political implications and potential for uncovering mismanagement.

ideas.title: The ActBlue Investigation: Uncovering Campaign Finance Practices
ideas.description: Investigate the federal investigation into ActBlue and its implications for Democrats' fundraising.
ideas.angle: Examine the investigation and potential impact on campaign finance.
questions: What are the allegations against ActBlue?
How might this impact Democrats' fundraising?
ideas.insight: The investigation could reveal significant information on campaign finance practices.
